definition: Heat absorbed divided by the temperature it is absorbed at.
name: Entropy

definition: Conservation of energy: heat in plus work done on a system is the rise in its energy.
name: FirstLaw

definition: Energy put into a system other than by doing work on it.
name: Heat

definition: A device that takes in heat, does work, and delivers heat at a lower temperature.

definition: The energy of a system; it rises by the heat put in plus the work done on it.
name: InternalEnergy
